detail.title: A kind of vacuum cup
detail.abstract: The present invention proposes a kind of vacuum cup, including sealing ring, disk body, suspended axle, sealing bolt and coupler body；It is characterized in that：Ring structure is installed on the disk body, the disk body other end is equipped with suspended axle and sealing bolt, the sealing bolt is connected with coupler body.The present invention has the characteristics that simple in structure, easy to use, durable.
